about_the_game:
Keytamine is a uniquely themed, rhythm-infused action game where you take on waves of rogue keycap enemies across beautifully crafted keyboard worlds.

Whether you're fighting for survival or just enjoying a chill session, the tactile satisfaction of typing sounds, smooth animations, and immersive ASMR design will keep you locked in. Inspired by bullet heaven and idle combat games, but with a clicky twist.

Key features:

  • Battle Waves of Enemies
    Fight your way through many ketcaps enemies and challenging elites, all themed around keyboard layouts. Each enemy is designed to test your reflexes and your build strategy.

  • Two Distinct Game Modes

    • Survivor Mode: Intense, wave-based combat where reflexes and smart upgrades are key to survival.

    • Relaxed Mode: No pressure, no death, just vibes, ambient feedback, and smooth animations for a more chill experience.

  • Level-Based Progression
    Progress through a structured series of keyboard-themed levels, each with its own atmosphere, layout, and challenges.

    Every level introduces a new, unique Key,  a powerful gameplay mechanic or modifier that dramatically changes how you play.

  • Rhythmic Combat Flow
    Combat is tightly interwoven with satisfying click-based rhythm, encouraging players to find the beat between inputs. Your actions, from attacking to dodging, produce custom keyboard sound feedback, turning chaotic fights into hypnotic symphonies of mechanical clacks.

What is included in this Demo?

  • Roughly 1 hour of unique content.

  • 2 Unique levels, with 24 basic keys, 4 elites, and 5 unique keys.

  • 7 Unique tools and 10 upgrades each.

  • Some Customization and upgrades.

What is included in the Full Game?

  • Roughly 12 hours of unique content.

  • 14 Unique levels, with 204 basic keys, 32 elites, and 21 unique keys.

  • 14 Unique tools and 20 upgrades each.

  • 80 Customization and 30 different types of meta progression upgrades.

  • Devil and Angel Deal system.
